title: An untracked part saves with its bin and quantity as a shelf reference
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab at {Location-A}.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • No part numbered {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-UNTRK-SAVE-01) exists at {Location-A} yet; this case creates it with the description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL UNTRACKED SHOP RAGS).
custom_steps:
1. Click New Inventory Part.
  2. Type {Description-A} in Description.
  3. Type {Part-A} in Part Number.
  4. Pick any Category (for example Uncategorized).
  5. Type 4.00 in Cost.
  6. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch so it is off.
  7. In the Inventory section set the Quantity of the {Bin-A} row to 12.
  8. Click Save.
  9. Type {Part-A} in the Inventory search.
  10. Click the {Part-A} row.
  11. Read the switch and the Inventory section of the dialog.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 8: The dialog closes and the part is saved; no bin error appears.
  • Step 9: One row is listed for {Part-A}; its Bin Location / Quantity cell reads "{Bin-A} | 12" and its Total Qty cell reads "Not Tracked".
  • Step 11: The Edit Inventory Part dialog shows the switch off, and the Inventory section still holds {Bin-A} with Quantity 12, the 12 typed in Step 7, unchanged.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S4-R6, S4-R6a, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.6 (Branch: a new part with tracking off) and create-note-6, 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R6: “When the switch is off, the bin location section stays visible and is optional. A bin can be set as a shelf reference without being required to save.”
  • S4-R6a: “The bins set on an untracked part are saved with their quantities, the same as on a tracked part.”
